## Personality

Stacy is a bright and sympathetic young woman. She possesses a natural ability to win and hold the affections of her pupils while bringing out the best in them both mentally and morally.

## History

Miss Stacy served as the schoolteacher in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), maintaining order without ever whipping her pupils. Upon starting her tenure, she proposed organizing a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert to raise funds for a school flag, which her students eagerly embraced. At the end of her first term, she announced she would return the following year to prepare students for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination, subsequently guiding them through their studies for the crucial tests. She eventually left [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after accepting a position at a grade school in her home district.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P2](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. ## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--stacy.md)

Miss Stacy serves as a dedicated teacher and mentor to [Anne](../character/anne.md), actively guiding her academic growth and advising her on her Second Year coursework. The two share a close, supportive friendship, with Miss Stacy encouraging [Anne](../character/anne.md) to mature into a well-rounded individual. From organizing a school concert to supporting [Anne](../character/anne.md) through her rigorous [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations, Miss Stacy remains a consistent source of inspiration and guidance.

- Friend of — good friend who encourages her to grow up right  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P8](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0008)</sub>
- Mentor of — teacher advising Anne on taking Second Year work  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--stacy.md)

Miss Stacy acts as both a teacher and a helpful friend to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). She first introduces new initiatives at school, such as a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert, and guides [Anne](../character/anne.md) through her academic development and preparations for Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams. Their relationship provides [Anne](../character/anne.md) with a positive role model as she navigates her studies and matures into a young teacher herself.

- Friend of — teacher and true and helpful friend  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
